acceptance: publish run preserves companion keys byte-for-byte apart from sanitization
fingerprint_varied and fingerprint_variants survive publish run
description: Found 2026-11-11. A run with --capture-plans writes a companion keyed `Q1#0:power` (22 keys for TPC-H). After `benchbox publish run <result> --target <local dir>` the published companion is keyed `1`, `10`, ... The entry content (plan, fingerprint, iteration, run_type, capture_time_ms) is unchanged. The companion is rebuilt from the loaded result, where each query has a single plan row, so `build_plans_payload` (benchbox/core/results/schema.py) takes its single-row branch and drops the stream and test-type qualifier. Consequences: the public companion no longer matches the documented key format, the Explorer labels lose the stream and phase, and a published companion cannot be joined back to the run output by key. The two bundles published on 2026-11-11 (tpch_sf01_duckdb_sql_20261111_154211_a31c24ca, tpch_sf01_polars_df_20261111_154204_3d7d3e84) carry bare keys. Also check that fingerprint_varied survives the same round trip, since it is derived from multiple rows per key.
